brief_summary: The aim of the study is to assess the efficacy and safety of XW003 injections in obese participants with OSA receiving PAP
brief_title: A Study of XW003 in Obese Participants With Obstructive Sleep Apnea Receiving Positive Airway Pressure Therapy
official_title: A Multi-center, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase III Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of XW003 Injections in Obese Participants With Obstructive Sleep Apnea Receiving Positive Airway Pressure Therapy

primary_outcomes.measure: Change from baseline in Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI)
